author: He Shi, School of Computing, National University of Singapore
required_final_artifacts: Runnable experiment logs from Ubuntu host
unverified_claims: OpenEvolve-style subproblem optimization improves downstream research outcomes.
The full co-pilot v3 system outperforms autonomous AI Scientist-v2 on selected tasks.
Current package satisfies artifact-delivery requirements, but top-conference empirical support remains incomplete; see top_conference_readiness_audit.md.
next_required_evidence: Run at least 5 matched-budget pairs per task across at least 3 tasks, with means, variance, and paired tests before making superiority claims.
Run matched mini-manuscript scoring on complete end-to-end co-pilot and autonomous manuscripts, not only package mini-manuscripts.
Demonstrate one continuous end-to-end trajectory from new hypothesis generation to experiments, claim audit, and final manuscript, plus a matched autonomous manuscript baseline.
Populate attention_cost and taste_insight in all future prospective human gates, then compare downstream outcomes and human effort.
Extend non-FML evidence beyond the scored MLAgentBench vectorization comparison to another official benchmark task when data access permits.
Rewrite the main manuscript into a focused conference-paper structure after stronger evidence is available; keep current version as pilot/reproducibility package.

model_routing_policy.hypothesis_debate: Monica-routed GPT/Gemini/Anthropic frontier model when budget allows
model_routing_policy.claim_audit: Monica-routed high-reliability model plus human review
model_routing_policy.api_secret_policy: Read from environment variables; never print keys.

openevolve_policy.reason: Official AlphaEvolve core algorithm and infrastructure are not open sourced.
openevolve_policy.first_task: examples/function_minimization smoke run or equivalent deterministic local task
openevolve_policy.required_comparison: direct LLM edit baseline under the same evaluator and iteration budget

commands_reran:
python3 - <<'PY'
# Validate manifest coverage, audit statuses, prospective package counts, and focused PDF rebuilds.
PY

checks.claim_boundary: Latest pushed verification package is clean-clone reproducible for local artifact, LHTG/DVRS, TFR, roadmap, human-expert packet readiness, benchmark coverage including open-data evaluator stress, prospective package summary, global skill engineering chain, focused accessibility revision, focused-PDF, package-consistency, and objective-delivery checks. This still does not rerun remote Ubuntu experiments or provide independent human expert evidence.

clean_clone_reproducibility_audit.interpretation: A fresh shallow clone of the pushed branch at commit 42cf5897d reproduced the current verification package with 895/895 manifest artifacts present. It reran LHTG/DVRS, TFR, the roadmap audit, human-expert packet readiness, benchmark coverage, prospective matched-package audit and summary, the global skill engineering chain audit, the focused accessibility revision audit, focused PDF builds, package consistency, and objective delivery audits. The result supports artifact reproducibility, skill engineering transfer, open-data evaluator-stress auditability, and workflow auditability, not top-conference empirical sufficiency.

prospective_matched_budget_package_audit.performance_evidence: prospective packages are mixed: FML pilots remain negative or invalid, controlled Max-Cut is positive, and open-data evaluator-stress is narrowly positive.

prospective_matched_package_summary.interpretation: 7 passing prospective packages; controlled Max-Cut is positive and open-data evaluator-stress is mixed but narrowly positive in aggregate, including held-out split validation for the trigger policy, while FML pilots remain negative or invalid; superiority_not_supported

online_trajectory_manuscript_probe.interpretation: This narrows the fresh online manuscript-production gap and adds a same-continuous-trajectory autonomous manuscript comparator; it remains a tiny-budget smoke without independent paper-quality review.

latest_online_full_gate_smoke.claim_scope: fresh same-continuous-trajectory paired online smoke plus manuscript production; not superiority evidence

online_matched_budget_manuscript_compara.interpretation: This adds an autonomous manuscript comparator to the online trajectory manuscript probe. It is a same-continuous-trajectory baseline when generated from the same online run; it still needs more tasks, seeds, and independent paper-quality review before supporting final paper-quality claims.

same_continuous_paper_quality_model_revi.limitation: Monica-routed model review over one tiny-budget same-continuous smoke; not independent human expert review.

structured_feedback_probe.scope_note: Same-base-manuscript, same-model probe comparing informal feedback against IGRE-structured feedback. This is measurement-readiness evidence only, not independent human expert review.

hypothesis_frontend_baseline_probe.scope_note: Same-model front-end portfolio comparison between archived IGRE hypothesis generation and an autonomous AI Scientist-v2-style baseline. This is direction-finding evidence only, not downstream benchmark or paper-quality evidence.

expert_review_taste_prior_probe.claim_boundary: Offline expert-review taste proxy only; not proof of live human co-pilot improvement.

participation_mode_selection_probe.claim_boundary: Offline OpenReview-derived model-routed workflow-selection probe only.

openreview_guided_regeneration_probe.claim_boundary: Real OpenReview text used as human taste/insight, but regenerated mini-paper artifacts only.

review_insight_taxonomy_probe.claim_boundary: OpenReview-derived actionable-review taxonomy only; not causal proof.

review_utility_map_probe.claim_boundary: Deterministic OpenReview utility map; not causal proof of final paper improvement.

openreview_regeneration_cross_model_revi.claim_boundary: Cross-model review reduces same-model scoring bias for regenerated mini-paper artifacts, but it is still model-routed artifact review, not independent human peer review or experiment rerun.

latest_paper_quality_review.claim_boundary: Focused manuscript has a clearer IGRE gate-routing contribution and new gate ablations, but remains a pilot until independent human ratings and real benchmark gate reruns are completed.

evidence_context: model-only blind packet dry-run negative result
focused_paper_quality_review.aggregate_conclusion: The refreshed focused reviews now include the mixed-negative evidence audit. GPT gives Weak accept, while Gemini gives Weak Reject: both treat IGRE/TFR as novel, transparent, and reproducible, but Gemini still rejects for top-conference readiness because empirical scale, independent human validation, real human-user studies, and broad matched benchmark gains are missing.
next_required_evidence: blind human expert ratings with inter-rater agreement
larger matched autonomous versus human-gated trajectories across tasks/seeds
real benchmark reruns where gate choices alter downstream experimental outcomes
small live human-user study measuring attention cost and usability
clearer abstract, running example, and broader domain/scalability discussion

openreview_equal_context_ablation.claim_boundary: This ablation controls for extra context by comparing real paper-specific review guidance against matched-length unrelated review context. It still uses model-routed scoring rather than independent human expert review, and does not rerun the original experiments.

summarizer_smoke.claim_boundary: Smoke test only; it uses the empty template and is not human evidence.

human_expert_blind_review_packet.claim_boundary: Prepared preregistered blind review materials and collection tooling only; no independent human expert results are claimed.

csv_validation.claim_boundary: Empty-template smoke and underpowered summaries are evaluation-readiness artifacts only; no human ratings are claimed until completed blind score sheets satisfy the preregistered thresholds.

preregistration.claim_boundary: Preregistration only; no independent human ratings have been collected.

retrospective_frontier_alignment_protoco.temporal_asymmetry_hypothesis: Short-term artifact quality can decrease while long-term frontier alignment increases.

smoke.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic smoke test for the retrospective frontier-alignment protocol. Frontier descriptors are manually specified placeholders, not a citation-backed SOTA reconstruction. Use it as pipeline evidence, not as proof that historical reviewers predicted later research.

retrospective_frontier_alignment_protoco.claim_boundary: The smoke proves pipeline executability and records a negative heuristic result; it does not prove literature-backed future-frontier alignment.

citation_probe.citation_source: Semantic Scholar Graph API with OpenAlex fallback
citation_probe.claim_boundary: This is a lightweight citation-backed pilot using retrieved Semantic Scholar metadata and simple term-overlap scoring. It is stronger than manual descriptors but still not a full citation graph reconstruction, blinded expert review, or proof of long-term SOTA alignment. It filters citations by lexical relevance, but thin or topically broad citation graphs can still produce misleading frontier terms.

retrospective_frontier_citation_probe.claim_boundary: Expanded citation-backed lexical frontier matching still finds no delayed-value review cases; this supports protocol readiness and a negative boundary, not the delayed-value hypothesis.

live_skill_invocation_smoke.safe_claim: The process outlines a reusable workflow that is structured to refine and validate research outputs.
live_skill_invocation_smoke.claim_boundary: This live skill invocation smoke verifies that the reusable Codex skill can be applied to a fresh research task with real model calls and produces a task spec, five-gate IGRE plan, and audit. It is not a benchmark result, not independent human review, and not evidence that IGRE improves paper quality or performance.

metric_gaming_evaluator_stress_smoke.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic evaluator-stress smoke linked to the live skill invocation. It demonstrates that a multi-metric guardrail can reject one synthetic metric-gaming candidate. It is not an FML-bench result, not a human-subject study, and not evidence that IGRE improves average benchmark performance.

fml_fairness_evaluator_stress_replay.claim_boundary: This is a replay over archived real FML-Bench Fairness_fairlearn evaluation artifacts. It supports evaluator-gate design against metric gaming, but it does not show a Fairness improvement, does not rerun the remote benchmark, and does not prove that IGRE improves average benchmark performance.

gate_structure_ablation_probe.claim_boundary: This is a deterministic routing ablation over archived OpenReview-derived review snippets. It supports the need for a multi-gate logging and routing structure, but it does not prove downstream paper-quality improvement, benchmark superiority, or independent human-review validity.

gate_outcome_attribution_probe.claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc attribution over six OpenReview regeneration pairs and model-review scores. It supports downstream gate-quality analysis as a design signal, but it does not prove causal improvement, independent human validity, or benchmark superiority.

single_gate_artifact_ablation.claim_boundary: This is a six-paper, model-reviewed OpenReview proxy using generated mini-paper artifacts. It is closer to a causal gate ablation than post-hoc attribution, but it does not replace independent human expert ratings, real benchmark reruns, or multi-task AI Scientist-v2 matched experiments.

review_frontier_signal_probe.claim_boundary: Review snippets contain routeable gates but do not outperform paper context under lexical citation-frontier scoring; stronger semantic and human-judged measures are required.

semantic_frontier_judge_probe.claim_boundary: Model-judged semantic matching addresses lexical limitations but still finds no delayed-value cases in the small sample; use as prioritization evidence, not proof.

temporal_frontier_replay_operational_spe.claim_boundary: TFR is operationalized and auditable, but the archived probes are negative for delayed-value human-review evidence. This supports a falsifiable protocol and a measurement boundary, not a positive long-horizon superiority claim.

high_tail_power_analysis.claim_boundary: This artifact operationalizes the high-tail hypothesis and shows that large matched samples are required. It is not evidence that IGRE has already increased breakthrough probability.

heldout_review_gate_validation.claim_boundary: Held-out validation supports stability of deterministic OpenReview-to-gate routing under a paper-level split. It does not provide independent human labels, does not prove downstream paper-quality improvement, and should be treated as an offline bias-reduction check for the review-derived gate policy.

delayed_value_review_candidate_mining.claim_boundary: Candidate screening for TFR replay, not positive delayed-value evidence.

delayed_value_candidate_frontier_validat.claim_boundary: OpenAlex lexical citation-frontier validation, not proof of causal delayed-value insight.

package_consistency_audit.claim_boundary: This audit checks package consistency, not scientific correctness or top-conference sufficiency. A pass means the artifact metadata agree.
warnings: clean-clone manifest_artifacts_checked does not match manifest current_artifacts length because clean-clone audit targets an ancestor commit
readiness clean-clone manifest count is stale because clean-clone audit targets an ancestor commit

lhtg_dvrs_audit.claim_boundary: LHTG/DVRS is operationalized as a routing and replay policy, but the current archived evidence validates only candidate prioritization and negative/weak TFR boundaries. It does not prove that human reviews improve long-horizon discovery.

objective_delivery_audit.head: 3b1634032253141b847abee6bdcd583d85eb6697
objective_delivery_audit.claim_boundary: The requested artifact pipeline is delivered and auditable, but the original top-conference empirical target remains incomplete until independent human ratings, larger matched benchmark runs, and broader end-to-end trajectories are collected.

prospective_gate_instrumentation_audit.claim_boundary: A pass means future prospective matched-budget runs have a documented preflight path for complete attention-cost and taste/insight capture. It does not repair missing historical fields and does not provide performance evidence.

mlagentbench_cifar10_debug_refresh_probe.claim_boundary: Setup evidence only; no second scored official non-FML benchmark result is reported.

related_work_coverage_map.claim_boundary: Coverage map for related-work positioning, not empirical evidence.

mlagentbench_clrs_baseline_smoke.claim_boundary: Setup and runtime-cost evidence only; no second scored official non-FML benchmark result is reported.

mlagentbench_clrs_reduced_smoke.claim_boundary: Reduced CLRS feasibility and cost evidence only; not an official MLAgentBench CLRS score.

delayed_value_deep_case_triage.claim_boundary: Triage selects future expensive replay cases; it is not positive delayed-value evidence.

delayed_value_replay_specs.claim_boundary: Replay specs are preregistration artifacts, not executed delayed-value evidence.

delayed_value_replay_case_execution.claim_boundary: This is one live model-generated four-condition mini-paper replay. It scores research-plan artifacts only; it does not rerun the original paper benchmarks, collect human expert ratings, or prove delayed-value review efficacy.

delayed_value_replay_cross_model_judge.claim_boundary: This cross-model judge scores already generated four-condition mini-paper artifacts. It reduces same-model scoring bias but is still model evaluation, not human expert review or benchmark execution.

live_tfr_replay_aggregate.claim_boundary: This aggregate summarizes model-generated mini-paper replay artifacts and model judges. It does not include benchmark reruns, human expert ratings, or proof that human reviews improve long-horizon scientific outcomes.

model_blind_review_dry_run.claim_boundary: Model-only dry run; not independent human expert evidence.

skill_engineering_release_strategy.boundary: Engineering adoption is usability and transfer evidence, not scientific superiority evidence.

standalone_skill_release_package.claim_boundary: Engineering release readiness is not scientific superiority evidence.
standalone_skill_release_package.base_skill_lineage: extends the existing ai-scientist-v2 Codex research-production loop with IGRE gates

igre_skill_install_smoke.claim_boundary: This smoke test verifies isolated local installability and release self-validation for the IGRE skill. It is engineering evidence, not scientific evidence that IGRE improves automated research outcomes.

global_copilot_skill_install.claim_boundary: This audit verifies that Co-Pilot AI Scientist v3 is installed as a global reusable Codex skill derived from the release package. It is engineering reuse evidence, not scientific superiority evidence.

global_skill_reuse_smoke.claim_boundary: This smoke verifies that the globally installed Co-Pilot AI Scientist v3 skill can instantiate a fresh research task, gate log, and claim audit. It is engineering reuse evidence, not benchmark, human, or scientific-superiority evidence.

global_skill_metric_gaming_evaluator_smo.claim_boundary: This executable toy evaluator is tied to the globally installed skill reuse smoke. It shows that the fresh evaluator-stress gate's guarded_evaluator decision rejects one synthetic metric-gaming winner. It is not an official benchmark, not human evidence, and not proof of average co-pilot superiority.

global_skill_engineering_chain_audit.claim_boundary: This audit verifies the engineering chain from standalone release scaffold through isolated install, global install, fresh global-skill reuse, clean external temporary reuse, and one toy evaluator-stress smoke. It is usability and reproducibility evidence, not independent human evidence, not an official benchmark result, and not proof that Co-Pilot AI Scientist v3 outperforms autonomous AI Scientist-v2.

prospective_matched_micro_pilot_ssh_maxc.claim_boundary: Controlled SSH Ubuntu micro-task; validates prospective matched-budget package shape and a machine-gradeable frontier-steering gate, not AI Scientist-v2 paper-quality superiority.

focused_paper_pdf_update_ssh_maxcut.claim_boundary: The focused manuscript includes the SSH Max-Cut micro-pilot as prospective package-shape and machine-gradeable frontier-steering evidence, not top-conference superiority evidence.

focused_paper_quality_review_refresh_ssh.claim_boundary: Model reviews are iteration evidence only and do not replace independent human expert review or larger matched benchmark runs.

focused_accessibility_revision_audit.purpose: Checks focused paper revisions for running example, ethics, governance, and cross-domain scalability terms.
focused_accessibility_revision_audit.claim_boundary: Presentation/scalability revision audit only; not empirical strength evidence.

external_clean_skill_reuse_smoke.claim_boundary: This smoke verifies clean external-environment reuse of the release skill on a fresh topic. It is engineering transfer evidence, not external-researcher evidence, human-review evidence, benchmark evidence, or scientific-superiority evidence.

clean_clone_reproducibility.claim_boundary: Held-out trigger-policy validation is open-data split validation within one task family; it improves participation-mode design evidence but does not prove broad benchmark or paper-quality superiority.

prospective_matched_open_data_multitask_.claim_boundary: trigger-policy design evidence from open-data split validation; not broad benchmark superiority
trigger-policy design evidence from open-data split validation; not broad benchmark superiority

evaluator_stress_trigger_policy_transfer.claim_boundary: This is a discovery-to-held-out split validation inside one open-data task family. It supports trigger-conditioned evaluator-stress design, not broad co-pilot superiority or a universally optimal threshold.

delayed_value_replay_multicase_audit.claim_boundary: A pass means multiple four-condition replay cases and cross-model judges were aggregated under the strict delayed-value rule. It is model-scored replay evidence, not benchmark execution or human expert validation.

base_skill_inheritance_audit.claim_boundary: This audit proves inheritance and packaging alignment: Co-Pilot AI Scientist v3 preserves the user's AI Scientist-v2 research-production loop and adds IGRE gates. It does not prove that the resulting workflow improves paper quality or benchmark performance.

prospective_attention_taste_cost_audit.claim_boundary: This audit supports prospective operator-recorded attention and taste/insight measurement across the matched-budget packages. It is not independent human-subject evidence, does not estimate population-level attention cost, and does not prove that human gates improve paper quality.

release_skill_trigger_policy_clean_clone.claim_boundary: Engineering release-sync evidence only; not scientific superiority evidence.
